typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Day as string,
		{Processed Events} as string,
		{Rejected Events} as string,
		{WFS Reject Rate %} as string,
		{Industry Reject Rate %} as string,
		{Green Thresh} as string,
		{Amber Thresh} as string,
		{Red Thresh} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CATRejectionRateFlatFileSource
CATRejectionRateFlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		greenThreshold as string,
		redThreshold as string,
		industryRejectRate as string,
		rateDate as string,
		processedEvents as string,
		rejectedEvents as string,
		wfsRejectRate as string,
		amberThreshold as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		greenThreshold = {Green Thresh},
		redThreshold = {Red Thresh},
		industryRejectRate = {Industry Reject Rate %},
		rateDate = Day,
		processedEvents = {Processed Events},
		rejectedEvents = {Rejected Events},
		wfsRejectRate = {WFS Reject Rate %},
		amberThreshold = {Amber Thresh}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
